params.body:
Three small things on the pages around the communities.

## Dutch: "community"

- The Dutch site said "Gemeenschappen" in the menu and footer and "gemeenschap" on the community pages, while the thing itself is called KUBO CyberSec **Community**. Dutch now says "community" and "communities" wherever a KUBO community is meant: menu, footer, homepage, the communities page and the CyberSec page.
- Not changed: "gemeenschap" where it means the people around a school (communities page) and "de ICT4D-gemeenschap" (approach page). French keeps "Communautés".

## CyberSec page: the link to the story of the day

- It was a small yellow text link between the three figures and the explanation, easy to miss.
- It is now an outlined button, placed after the facts of the day. The filled yellow button stays reserved for showing the number.

## CyberSec page: the invitation to the next event

- The block with the invitation, the organiser and the number button sat at the bottom of the left column, beside an empty corner under the photos.
- It is now a band across both columns that closes the section: the words on the left, the person and the button on the right. On a narrow screen it stacks as before.
- The order of the section reads: what the day was, the facts, the full story, then the next one.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 29 passed. `npm run build` and `npm run check:built`: no contact number.
- CyberSec page in en, nl and fr at 1440 wide, Dutch also at 1000 and 390: no horizontal scroll, no page errors, and the number button still shows the number after a click.
params.title: Dutch "community", and a clearer end to the event section on the CyberSec page
